name: photoreal-tech-explainer
summary: Cinematic dark photoreal 3D explainer: ray-traced macro hero shots of everyday objects under a soft key + warm amber rim, karaoke top captions with an iOS selection-box key word, reacting cartoon mascot, dense tactile sound design.

source.notes: 55s vertical reel about tire manufacturing. Style only; no watermark, mascot likeness, or transcript cloned. Extends the sibling 'mascot-tech-explainer' caption/mascot system with a photoreal 3D stage.

pacing.curve: continuous-morph between 3D scenes; camera never static; caption beat every 1.5-2.5s carries rhythm

palette.mood: near-black studio; subjects drawn by light; amber = heat/highlight, blue reserved for caption selection boxes

typography.fallback_stack: -apple-system, SF Pro Display, Inter, Helvetica Neue, sans-serif

highlight.description: Key word in an iOS text-selection box (rounded blue outline, two circular handles); occasionally an inline emoji before the boxed word (🔥 170°C).

captions.word_reveal: words of the phrase fade in one-by-one with the VO (karaoke), ~120ms crossfade each

layout.description: Caption band top 7-14%; photoreal 3D stage 15-80% (full-bleed render); mascot ~18% height bottom-center, pose crossfades ~150ms on beats.
recurring_devices: thin white annotation lines with dot endpoints labeling 3D parts (AIR, DENT, 170°C, BLADDER 350 PSI)
tiny gray corner footnotes ('Magnified illustration', 'Heat shown in colour')
measurement labels in small caps tracking wide
physical gauges/dials with animating needles as evidence devices

shots.camera: low-angle macro pushes; slow orbits on hero objects; rack focus; always drifting
transitions: rare hard cut at chapter changes

lighting.rig: large soft area key high-left ~35° down; strong warm amber rim/spot behind-left grazing silhouette and pooling on floor; faint cool blue fill behind-right; near-black world

materials.color: very dark or saturated product color

camera.easing: ease-in-out full shot; element entrances ease-out ~300ms

particles: scatter/instanced micro-detail on hero objects (hairs, debris, sparks)

audio.music: minimal; VO dominant; room tone under everything

sfx.bed: low room tone -26dB; never dead air except a deliberate 0.3s beat before the payoff

script_formula.hook: Surprising measurable claim about an everyday object in <3s ('Every X ... is/does Y').
structure: process/mechanism shown step by step on the 3D stage
script_formula.sentence_style: short, 2nd person, present tense; one idea per caption beat
script_formula.cta: share sheet scene as the final shot

renderer_hints.notes: Hero shots via blender_shot.py (studio rig per scene_3d.lighting, fps-render 10-12, samples 24-32, scale 0.45-0.5, motion-interpolated). Composite in Remotion as OffthreadVideo under the caption band + mascot. Captions/mascot identical system to mascot-tech-explainer. SFX via synth_sfx.py placed by sfx.grammar.
